description:
Preview local or toll-free SMS registration text without filing or charging.

        The response contains the description, consent flow and samples for user review before submission.
        Answers require actual applicant information and consent evidence.
        Evidence links can come from ``create_file_upload`` with purpose ``sms_evidence``.
        Field or length errors appear in ``problems``.
        Limits are 100 fields and 64 KiB of combined fields and address.
        A successful preview does not guarantee submission: duplicates, low credit or carrier checks can still prevent it.

city.description: City or town as it appears in the applicant's mailing address.
city.title: City

postal_code.description: Postal or ZIP code of the street address, such as `94103`.
postal_code.title: Postal Code

region.description: State, province, or equivalent administrative area in the applicant's address.
region.title: Region

address.description: The applicant's address. Give it when the requirements include one; otherwise leave it out.
address.title: Address

fields.description: Proposed applicant answers keyed by the field names in ``get_verification_requirements`` with purpose ``sms``.
fields.title: Fields

llm_model.description: The calling agent's provider model ID, as shown in the client's model configuration when available. Recorded for analytics.

number_id.description: Owned toll-free number ID from ``list_numbers``, for a toll-free preview. Omitted: a US local preview.
number_id.title: Number Id

subject_type.description: Who the registration is for: the user themselves (``person``) or their company (``business``).
subject_type.title: Subject Type

name: preview_sms_application

problems.description: Validation issues with an input path and a message.

title: Preview a US texting registration
